services.title: Tree Trimming & Pruning
services.shortDescription: Precision trimming and pruning that keeps your trees healthy, shaped, and safe year-round.
services.longDescription: Overgrown limbs put your roof, power lines, and family at risk. Our crew trims and prunes with the health of the tree in mind, removing dead or crossing branches, improving airflow and sunlight, and shaping trees to complement your property. Every cut is made using proper arborist technique, not just a chainsaw and a ladder.
signals: Limbs hanging over your roof, driveway, or power lines
Branches rubbing or crossing each other in the canopy
A tree that hasn't been trimmed in several years
Thin, lopsided, or patchy growth blocking light unevenly
Storm-damaged or split limbs still hanging in the tree
process: Free on-site walk-through to look at each tree and flag anything hazardous
We explain what we're cutting and why before any chainsaw starts
Proper pruning cuts, not topping, so the tree heals and grows back healthy
Full cleanup when we're done: branches chipped or hauled, yard raked clean

faq.q: How often should trees be trimmed?
faq.a: Most mature trees do well with trimming every 2-3 years. Younger or fast-growing trees may need more frequent attention. We can recommend a schedule when we take a look at your property.

faq.q: Will trimming hurt the tree?
faq.a: Not when it's done right. We make cuts in the right spots so the tree heals and grows back healthy instead of getting stressed or damaged.

faq.q: Do you top trees?
faq.a: No. Topping (cutting main branches back to stubs) weakens a tree and usually causes worse, weaker regrowth. We use proper crown reduction and thinning cuts instead.

faq.q: What time of year is best for trimming?
faq.a: Late winter, while trees are dormant, is usually best for major pruning. Dead, damaged, or hazardous limbs get taken care of any time of year, storm or no storm.

services.title: Tree Removal
services.shortDescription: Safe, complete removal of dead, dying, or unwanted trees of any size.
services.longDescription: When a tree is dead, diseased, leaning, or simply in the wrong spot, our team removes it safely and completely, protecting your home, fence, and landscaping in the process. We handle everything from single backyard trees to large, hazardous removals near structures and power lines, and we haul away every branch and log when we're done.
signals: A dead, hollow, or visibly rotting trunk
A tree leaning more than it used to, or roots heaving near the base
Storm damage that's split the trunk or a major limb
A tree that's simply in the way of a new structure, driveway, or addition
Disease or pest damage that isn't getting better
process: Free assessment of the tree's lean, root condition, and proximity to structures or lines
We walk you through the plan and price before any cutting starts
Controlled, sectional removal in tight spots so nothing lands where it shouldn't
Full haul-away of branches and logs, with the stump left ready for grinding if you want it gone too

faq.q: How do you remove a tree near my house or power lines?
faq.a: For tight spots we take the tree down in sections instead of felling it all at once, so your home, fence, and any nearby lines stay protected.

faq.q: Do I need a permit to remove a tree?
faq.a: It depends on your city and whether the tree sits on a property line. We can help you sort out what's needed before we start the job.

faq.q: What happens to the wood?
faq.a: We haul away everything by default, unless you'd like the logs left behind for firewood. Just let us know before we start and we'll leave what you want.

faq.q: Will removing a tree tear up my yard?
faq.a: We're careful about how we get equipment in and out, and we clean up any ruts, debris, or sawdust before we call the job done.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.shortDescription: Fast, thorough stump grinding that clears the way for a clean, usable yard.
services.longDescription: A leftover stump is a tripping hazard, a mower headache, and an eyesore. We grind stumps of any size down below grade so you can reclaim the space, replant, or landscape right over it. Fast turnaround, minimal mess, and a clean finish every time.
signals: A stump that's a mowing or tripping hazard
Wanting to replant, reseed, or landscape right over the spot
Getting a yard ready to sell
Old stumps left behind from tree work someone else did
process: We grind below grade, not just flush, so nothing's left to trip over or dull a mower blade
The root flare and visible surface roots get ground down along with the stump
Wood chips from the grind are left for you to use as mulch, or hauled off if you'd rather
Hole gets backfilled so the area is ready to landscape or reseed

faq.q: How far below the surface do you grind?
faq.a: We grind stumps below grade, not just flush with the ground, so you can plant, seed, or landscape right over the spot afterward.

faq.q: What happens to the wood chips?
faq.a: We can leave the mulch for you to use around your yard, or haul it off, whichever you'd rather have.

faq.q: Do you remove the roots too?
faq.a: We grind down the visible root flare and surface roots near the stump. Deeper roots stay in the ground - they break down naturally over time and won't send up new sprouts once the stump itself is gone.

faq.q: Can I plant something right where the stump was?
faq.a: Yes, once we've backfilled the hole. Give the ground a little time to settle first if you're planting something with real roots.

services.title: Storm Damage & Emergency Tree Removal
services.shortDescription: Rapid response emergency tree removal and storm debris cleanup after high winds and fallen limbs.
services.longDescription: When a storm drops a tree on your property, you need someone there fast. We provide rapid-response storm cleanup, removing downed trees and limbs from roofs, driveways, fences, and yards, and clearing debris so your property is safe again.
signals: A tree or large limb already down on your property
A leaning tree that looks like it could go next
Storm damage blocking your driveway or the only way in or out
Limbs hung up in other trees after high wind - dangerous "widowmakers" waiting to fall
process: Call us - we prioritize storm and emergency calls ahead of routine scheduling
We assess what's actually dangerous first, like leaning trees or hung-up limbs, before touching anything else
Safe removal of downed trees and limbs off roofs, cars, fences, and driveways
Full property cleanup once everything is safely down and hauled off

faq.q: A tree fell on my roof or fence, what do I do?
faq.a: Call us right away. We treat storm calls as a priority and get downed trees and limbs off your structures safely before starting the rest of the cleanup.

faq.q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
faq.a: We can document the damage with photos and notes from the job, which you can pass along to your homeowner's insurance.

faq.q: How fast can you get here after a storm?
faq.a: We prioritize storm and emergency calls ahead of routine scheduling and do our best to get a crew out the same day. Call as soon as it's safe to do so.

faq.q: Is storm damage covered by insurance?
faq.a: Often, yes, especially if a tree damaged your home, fence, or another structure. We can document the damage for your claim, but you'll want to confirm your specific coverage with your insurance company.

services.title: Land Clearing & Maintenance
services.shortDescription: Lot clearing, brush removal, and general land maintenance to open up and clean up your property.
services.longDescription: Whether you're clearing a lot for a new build, opening up an overgrown property line, or just need brush and undergrowth cleared out, we have the equipment and manpower to get it done efficiently and leave your land clean and usable.
signals: Prepping a lot for a new build or addition
Opening up an overgrown property line or fence line
Reclaiming a backyard that's grown wild
Clearing brush for better visibility, access, or fire safety
process: We walk the property with you and mark what stays and what goes
Clear brush, undergrowth, and unwanted trees with equipment sized to the job
Haul off debris, or leave it stacked or chipped, whichever you'd rather
Leave the cleared area graded and usable, not just cut down and left

faq.q: What size lots can you clear?
faq.a: Anything from a small overgrown backyard to a larger building site. We scale the crew and equipment to fit the job.

faq.q: Can you work around fences or structures I want to keep?
faq.a: Yes, we clear carefully around anything you point out ahead of time, whether it's a fence, shed, or landscaping.

faq.q: Can you clear just part of my property?
faq.a: Yes. We mark boundaries with you beforehand so only the area you actually want cleared gets touched.

faq.q: What happens to everything you clear?
faq.a: We haul off brush and debris by default. If you'd rather have it left stacked or chipped on site, just let us know before we start.
